verses.translation: A Psalm of David concerning Goliad. Blessed be the Lord my God, who instructs my hands for battle, and my fingers for war.

translations.ron: Binecuvântat este Domnul Dumnezeul meu, Cel ce învaţă mâinile mele la luptă şi degetele mele la război.
translations.grk: Τῷ Δαυὶδ πρὸς τὸν Γολιάδ. Εὐλογήτος Κύριος ὁ Θεός μου, ὁ διδάσκων τὰς χεῖράς μου εἰς παράταξιν, τοὺς δακτύλους μου εἰς πόλεμον·

verses.translation: My mercy, and my refuge; my helper, and my deliverer; my protector, in whom I have trusted; who subdues my people under me.

translations.ron: Mila mea şi Scăparea mea, Sprijinitorul meu şi Izbăvitorul meu, Apărătorul meu, şi în El am nădăjduit, Cel ce supune pe poporul meu sub mine.
translations.grk: Ἔλεός μου καὶ καταφυγή μου, ἀντιλήπτωρ μου καὶ ῥύστης μου, ὑπερασπιστής μου, καὶ ἐπʼ αὐτῷ ἤλπισα, ὁ ὑποτάσσων τὸν λαόν μου ὑπʼ ἐμέ.

verses.translation: Lord, what is man, that thou art made known to him? or the son of man, that thou takest account of him?

translations.ron: Doamne, ce este omul că Te-ai făcut cunoscut lui, sau fiul omului că-l socoteşti pe el?
translations.grk: Κύριε, τί ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος, ὅτι ἐγνώσθης αὐτῷ; ἢ υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου, ὅτι λογίζῃ αὐτόν;

verses.translation: Man is like to vanity: his days pass as a shadow.

translations.ron: Omul cu deşertăciunea se aseamănă; zilele lui ca umbra trec.
translations.grk: Ἄνθρωπος ματαιότητι ὡμοιώθη, αἱ ἡμέραι αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ σκιὰ παράγουσι.

verses.translation: O Lord, bow thy heavens, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

translations.ron: Doamne, pleacă cerurile şi Te pogoară, atinge-Te de munţi şi fă-i să fumege.
translations.grk: Κύριε, κλῖνον οὐρανούς σου καὶ κατάβηθι, ἅψαι τῶν ὀρέων καὶ καπνισθήσονται.

verses.translation: Send lightning, and thou shalt scatter them: send forth thine arrows, and thou shalt discomfit them.

translations.ron: Cu fulger fulgeră-i şi-i risipeşte! Trimite săgeţile Tale şi tulbură-i!
translations.grk: Ἄστραψον ἀστραπὴν καὶ σκορπιεῖς αὐτοὺς, ἐξαπόστειλον τὰ βέλη σου καὶ συνταράξεις αὐτούς.

verses.translation: Send forth thine hand from on high; rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hand of strange children;

translations.ron: Trimite mâna Ta dintru înălţime; scoate-mă şi mă izbăveşte de ape multe, din mâna străinilor,
translations.grk: Ἐξαπόστειλον τὴν χεῖρά σου ἐξ ὕψους, ἐξελοῦ με καὶ ῥῦσαί με ἐξ ὑδάτων πολλῶν, ἐκ χειρὸς υἱῶν ἀλλοτρίων·

verses.translation: whose mouth has spoken vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of iniquity.

translations.ron: A căror gură a grăit deşertăciune şi dreapta lor e dreapta nedreptăţii.
translations.grk: ὧν τὸ στόμα ἐλάλησε ματαιότητα, καὶ ἡ δεξιὰ αὐτῶν δεξιὰ ἀδικίας.

verses.translation: O God, I will sing a new song to thee: I will play to thee on a psaltery of ten strings.

translations.ron: Dumnezeule, cântare nouă Îţi voi cânta ţie; în psaltire cu zece strune Îţi voi cânta ţie,
translations.grk: Ὁ Θεὸς, ᾠδὴν καινὴν ᾄσομαί σοι, ἐν ψαλτηρίῳ δεκαχόρδῳ ψαλῶ σοι·

verses.translation: Even to him who gives salvation to kings: who redeems his servant David from the hurtful sword.

translations.ron: Celui ce dai mântuire împăraţilor, Celui ce izbăveşti pe David, robul Tău, din robia cea cumplită.
translations.grk: Τῷ διδόντι τὴν σωτηρίαν τοῖς βασιλεῦσι, τῷ λυτρουμένῳ Δαυὶδ τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ ἐκ ῥομφαίας πονηρᾶς.

verses.translation: Deliver me, and rescue me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth has spoken vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of iniquity;

translations.ron: Izbăveşte-mă şi mă scoate din mâna străinilor, a căror gură a grăit deşertăciune şi dreapta lor e dreapta nedreptăţii,
translations.grk: Ῥῦσαί με καὶ ἐξελοῦ με ἐκ χειρὸς υἱῶν ἀλλοτρίων, ὧν τὸ στόμα ἐλάλησε ματαιότητα, καὶ ἡ δεξιὰ αὐτῶν δεξιὰ ἀδικίας·

verses.translation: whose children are as plants, strengthened in their youth: their daughters are beautiful, sumptuously adorned after the similitude of a temple.

translations.ron: Ai căror fii sunt ca nişte odrasle tinere, crescute în tinereţile lor; fiicele lor înfrumuseţate şi împodobite ca chipurile templului.
translations.grk: ὧν οἱ υἱοὶ ὡς νεόφυτα ἱδρυμένα ἐν τῇ νεότητι αὐτῶν· αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῶν κεκαλλωπισμέναι, περικεκοσμημέναι ὡς ὁμοίωμα ναοῦ.

verses.translation: Their garners are full, and bursting with one kind of store after another; their sheep are prolific, multiplying in their streets.

translations.ron: Cămările lor pline, vărsându-se din una în alta. Oile lor cu mulţi miei, umplând drumurile când ies;

verses.translation: Their oxen are fat: there is no falling down of a hedge, nor going out, nor cry in their folds.

translations.ron: Boii lor sunt graşi. Nu este gard căzut, nici spărtură, nici strigare în uliţele lor.

verses.translation: Men bless the people to whom this lot belongs, but blessed is the people whose God is the Lord.

translations.ron: Au fericit pe poporul care are aceste bunătăţi. Dar fericit este poporul acela care are pe Domnul ca Dumnezeu al său.
